summary: Bio Essence Corp filed an 8-K on April 24, 2026, reporting its entry into an Asset Purchase Agreement with Zhituo Software Co., Limited dated April 20, 2026. Under the APA, Bio Essence acquires the MediFlow AI software (previously AcuVital), including its source code, system architecture, data, and related technical information. In exchange, Zhituo will receive Bio Essence common stock valued at $3,500,000, subject to board approval of the number of shares. No prior relationship existed between the parties. The board approved the transaction via consent resolution. No other special-situation features (e.g., premiums, dates, regulatory clocks) are present.
